STEP 3 OF 8

Routing

Choose how participants are sequenced and whether they act simultaneously or one at a time.

Sequential — one step at a time

Need named stages and per-person requirements?

After this document exists, its Signing Workflow tab can turn the routing order below into named stages — each with an explicit required action and an individual electronic signature requirement for every person. Routing configured here keeps working on its own, and nothing here depends on Workflow Automation.

Routing mode
Parallel — everyone at once
All participants in each routing group may act simultaneously, without waiting for one another.
Sequential — one step at a time
Each routing step begins only after all required participants in the previous step complete their actions.
Mixed — groups, each in parallel
Multiple participants may act in parallel within ordered routing steps.
Approval-based — approve before sign
An Approver or Reviewer step must complete before later signing or acknowledgment steps begin.

STEP 4 OF 8

Settings

Choose when participants are reminded, set an optional expiration date, and choose whether participants are emailed the completed document.

Reminders on · No expiration · Completed copy emailed
Invitation
Each participant is emailed a private signing link when their turn comes.

Recipients see Local Owner as the sender — your profile's Sender Display name. Change it in Settings › Profile.

Reminders
Reminder emails to participants who have not yet acted.
Remind participants who have not acted
Each participant is reminded by email, counting from when it became their turn.
First reminder after
days
Then every
days

Up to 3 reminders, until they act. Reminders stop when the document is completed, declined, cancelled or expires.

Expiration
Optional. Close signing on a date you choose. Without one, the document waits until it is signed.
Set an expiration date
Signing closes at the end of this day, Philippine time. Anyone who has not acted by then can no longer sign.
Completion
What happens when all required participants have completed their actions.
Email participants the completed document
When everyone has finished, each participant is emailed a link to download the completed document. The link works for 30 days. Viewers are not sent one. Switch this off for a sensitive document: participants can still open it in LAGDA under Records.

REMINDERS & EXPIRY

Reminders: first after 3 days, then every 3 days.
No expiration date set.
